Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the questions. Short answers below and attaching a KMS integration note: 

1) Customer-managed KMS: yes — we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations for both hosted and private deployments. We’ve included a short integration note in the attachment outlining supported providers and key rotation recommendations.
2) KV/cache retention: our serving runtime provides configurable TTLs and explicit purge endpoints; by default we do not persist user prompt/response tensors beyond session unless configured. The SOC 2 packet includes the retention policy section, but I’ve highlighted the relevant pages in the attached doc.

Attachment: FintechCo_SOC2_packet_2026-07-10.pdf (updated: KMS_note added)

If it helps, Ethan can join a 30-min call next Tue (7/21) at 10am PT to walk your security team through the integration details. Rachel (CC’d) will handle any implementation/CS questions afterwards.

Best,
